Interpretation note解释说明

Hot Signals means at least two positive cross-snapshot changes: review growth, recommended-position rise, price down, or rating up. It is not an official Wayfair bestseller label.热门信号指跨快照至少出现两项正向变化：评论增长、推荐位置上升、价格下降或评分上升；它不是 Wayfair 官方 Best Seller 标签。

Images use the Actor image URL when it is usable. For suspicious or missing images, the optional fallback reads image metadata from the existing Wayfair listing URL; blocked or missing pages remain explicitly marked.图片优先使用 Actor 返回的可用图片 URL；对于可疑或缺失图片，系统可用现有 Wayfair listing URL 读取页面图片元数据；页面被拦截或没有图片时会继续明确标记。
